newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GOVERNMENT FINES IMPAR OVER TAX.
newsitem.headline: GOVERNMENT FINES IMPAR OVER TAX.

text.p: The government imposed a four million litas fine on food wholesaler and retailer Impar for destroying cash register receipts and denying officials access to its books, the government said in a statement Tuesday.

The government press office said in a statement that the firm broke book-keeping rules and that cash register rolls for the previous year had been destroyed and that a four million litas fine had been imposed.
The fine is the largest since Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius started a campaign against tax evasion.
More than 7,500 companies have been checked and over 13 million litas in fines imposed, the government press office added.
